commentary.text: 90+5' Marco Di Bello is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' AS Roma work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+4' That will be all from Niccolo Pisilli who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma).
90+4' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+3' Remo Freuler (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but Mile Svilar comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+3' Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
89' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
88' Bologna are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bologna are taking a throw-in.
87' The linesman signals a throw-in for AS Roma.
82' AS Roma fail to score from a corner as Federico Ravaglia (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.
80' A player from Bologna brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
77' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Eivind Fauske Helland (Bologna) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Martin Vitik.
77' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) replaces Riccardo Orsolini.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Donyell Malen trots off the pitch and is replaced by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).
76' Bologna are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
75' 59:41 – the latest ball possession ratio.
73' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
71' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Di Bello had an easy-decision to make.
66' Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
66' Joao Mario (Bologna) is substituted due to injury. Vincenzo Italiano gives a chance to Lorenzo De Silvestri.
65' Joao Mario (Bologna) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
64' Robinio Vaz (AS Roma) forces a pass into the box, but Federico Ravaglia is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
61' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Matias Soule is replaced by Robinio Vaz (AS Roma).
61' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mario Hermoso as he is replaced by Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma).
60' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) misses a great chance. He gets to the rebound inside the box and sees his shot smash against the crossbar!
60' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
58' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
55' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar.
55' Bologna take a short corner kick.
53' The ball is behind the sideline. Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) takes a throw-in.
53' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes.
51' Matias Soule (AS Roma) is flagged for offside.
46' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) has tested the patience of referee Marco Di Bello and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' Half-time substitution. Gian Piero Gasperini decided to make a change. Zeki Celik is replaced by Devyne Rensch (AS Roma).
46' Half-time substitution. Santiago Castro is replaced by Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
46' Half-time substitution. Juan Miranda (Bologna) will not participate anymore and Nadir Zortea is coming on.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Marco Di Bello has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Good work from Bologna as they win a corner.
45+1' 0 - 2 Donyell Malen plays a terrific cross over to Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma), who finds some space inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
45+1' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Neat passing move from Bologna in order to create new attacking opportunities.
44' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AS Roma.
42' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) takes a pot shot from distance after a rebound fell kindly for him, but it's blocked by an opponent.
39' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
38' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
37' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Donyell Malen (AS Roma). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
35' The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a throw-in.
33' A clumsy foul by Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle.
32' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
31' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Mile Svilar.
31' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
28' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) brings his opponent down. Marco Di Bello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
26' CLOSE! Donyell Malen (AS Roma) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
24' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
22' The resulting corner from Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) is cleared.
20' Juan Miranda (Bologna) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
18' This shall not pass! Santiago Castro (Bologna) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
16' The Bologna players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
14' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
13' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
10' AS Roma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
9' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

7' 0 - 1 Goal! Neil El Aynaoui sets up Donyell Malen (AS Roma) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
5' Matias Soule (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Federico Ravaglia intercepts the ball.
5' AS Roma quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
3' Santiago Castro (Bologna) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
